name: @krn/agent-skills
description: KRN's universal Codex skill workflows, compact context spine, and deterministic harness gates.

scripts.gate: npm run validate && npm run test:bootstrap && npm run test:install && npm run test:hooks && npm run test:state && npm run test:skills && npm run skills:check && npm run lessons:verify && npm run changes:check && npm run test:lessons && npm run test:lessons-verify && npm run test:change-contract && npm run test:durable-pages && npm run test:catalog && npm run test:setup && npm run test:skill-scripts && npm run test:lib && bash -n scripts/install.sh && bash -n skills/advisory/opencode-second-opinion/scripts/check-opinion.sh && bash -n skills/advisory/opencode-second-opinion/scripts/run-opinion.sh && git diff --check
scripts.changes:check: base=$(git merge-base origin/main HEAD 2>/dev/null || true); if [ -z "$base" ] || [ "$base" = "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" ]; then base=HEAD~1; fi; node scripts/krn-codex.mjs changes check --root . --base "$base" --head HEAD
scripts.changes:push: base=${KRN_PUSH_BASE:-$(git merge-base origin/main HEAD 2>/dev/null || true)}; [ "$base" = "0000000000000000000000000000000000000000" ] && base=''; resolved=$(git rev-parse --verify "${base:-HEAD}^{commit}" 2>/dev/null || true); if [ -z "$base" ] || [ -z "$resolved" ] || [ "$resolved" = "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" ]; then base="$(git rev-parse HEAD~1 2>/dev/null)"; fi; if [ -z "$base" ]; then echo 'changes:push: no base range (root commit)' >&2; base="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"; fi; node scripts/krn-codex.mjs changes check --root . --base "$base" --head HEAD
scripts.test:lib: node --test test/support/diagnostics.test.mjs test/support/fences.test.mjs test/support/repo-root.test.mjs test/support/git-cli.test.mjs test/state/spine-runs.test.mjs test/contract/runtime-closure.test.mjs test/audit/quality-audit.test.mjs test/audit/quality-audit-dynamic-import.test.mjs test/support/source-mask.test.mjs test/support/symbol-triggers.test.mjs test/support/churn.test.mjs test/rules/skill-rules.test.mjs test/catalog/catalog-desired.test.mjs test/catalog/catalog-profile.test.mjs test/catalog/catalog-config.test.mjs test/install/skill-metadata.test.mjs test/install/install-policy.test.mjs test/catalog/plugin-identity.test.mjs test/catalog/catalog-path-safety.test.mjs test/catalog/catalog-plan.test.mjs test/catalog/catalog-usage-json.test.mjs test/catalog/catalog-usage-shell.test.mjs test/catalog/catalog-usage-normalize.test.mjs test/catalog/catalog-usage-paths.test.mjs test/catalog/catalog-usage-lines.test.mjs test/catalog/catalog-usage-scan.test.mjs test/catalog/catalog-profiles.test.mjs test/catalog/catalog-inventory-roots.test.mjs test/catalog/catalog-inventory-plugins.test.mjs test/catalog/catalog-inventory-quarantine-branches.test.mjs test/catalog/catalog-inventory-quarantine.test.mjs test/contract/delivery-loop-rules.test.mjs test/catalog/catalog-toml.test.mjs test/catalog/catalog-document.test.mjs test/rules/content-rules.test.mjs test/contract/upstream-sources.test.mjs test/contract/manifest-rules.test.mjs test/ci-workflow.test.mjs test/contract/integration-memory.test.mjs test/contract/guard-inheritance.test.mjs
